exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (transitive) to bring, to fetch (to transport toward someone/somewhere by vehicle)
to see, to catch sight of, to notice
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приноси́ть — to bring (by foot), to fetch; привезти́ — (transitive) to bring, to fetch (to transport toward someone/somewhere by vehicle); уви́деть — to see, to catch sight of, to notice; узна́ть — to recognize.
**привёл** — привести́ (perfective): to bring (someone with); to lead (of a road); to result, to lead, to bring; (mathematics) to reduce. Wiktionary: при- + вести́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

pairs: to have time, to find time
to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance)

**ушёл** — уйти́ (perfective): to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); to escape, to evade; (colloquial) to resign, to retire; to be lost. Wiktionary: у- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
